promptChangelog: Targets name-mismatch: the claimantName schema description said "policyholder or claimant", which are opposite parties on a liability claim. Now defines it as the policyholder explicitly. Single-string change; instructions and all other field descriptions identical to v1.

failures.note: High on the injury limb. The surgery date (9 February) is a distractor for the accident date. "so far" signals an open-ended total, but a single stated figure is still extractable.
Pre-approval request rather than a claim. The prescription date is the only date in the document and stands in for the loss date - a judgement call, recorded here so the label is reproducible.

High on the injury limb - the injured person is a third party, which the rubric does not distinguish. The name trap is structural to liability claims: the claimant is the policyholder (Claudia Rieder), not the injured neighbour (Erika Sommer).

High on the deadline limb with no injury and an amount under 50k - the only document in the set where the deadline alone carries the urgency. Three competing names (insured, claimant company, opposing lawyer) and a law-firm reference posing as an identifier.
